A few words about me

I create original music, detailed sound worlds and a clean, balanced mix. I care about narrative and how sound supports emotion.

Who I am

Lochin Wilde, 29. Composer, sound designer and mixing engineer — in music since 2009, more in‑depth since 2011.

I work where music meets sound: composing original scores, building soundscapes and handling mixing/mastering. I focus on storytelling, mood, and the way audio helps the project speak.

Open to working with games, films and series, ads, online courses, podcasts and personal brands. Formats range from one‑off tasks to full audio supervision.

Services

Key ways I can help your project sound stronger.

Music for games, film and brands

Original music tailored to your narrative: from subtle themes to dense orchestral textures and electronic scores.

Sound design & ambience

Creating sound worlds: ambience, UI and gameplay SFX, foley and emotional accents that make visuals feel alive.

Mixing & mastering

Clear balance, depth and dynamics. Preparing material for release or integration into games, film, ads or platforms.

Programs

Tools I build for myself and for fellow DJs.

Muzykalny Sortir

Closed beta

Sorts a DJ library by genre, detects BPM and Camelot key, and evens out loudness. It runs entirely in the browser: nothing to install, and your files are never uploaded — everything is analysed on your own machine.

  • Library sorted by genre
  • BPM and Camelot key
  • Loudness levelling
  • Nothing to install
Open the app Source on GitHub

Entry is by invite code — the app is still in closed testing.
